name: RH56F2
summary: RH56F2 is INSPIRE ROBOTS' integrated metal-bodied dexterous hand with six degrees of freedom and 12 joints. Its design combines force, position and temperature feedback, while tactile-equipped versions add eight tactile sensors. The manufacturer lists a 605 ±10 g mass, ±0.2 mm fingertip repeatability and a closing time of no more than 0.8 seconds. Communication depends on the version: EtherCAT is paired with RS485 or CAN FD. Tactile and non-tactile variants are documented separately, and static load figures should not be interpreted as active fingertip gripping force.
